ck_bookings_end_shape.name: ck_bookings_end_shape
ck_bookings_end_shape.value: ("bookings"."time_model" = 'day' and "bookings"."end_local" is null) or ("bookings"."time_model" <> 'day' and "bookings"."end_local" is not null)

ck_bookings_idempotency.name: ck_bookings_idempotency
ck_bookings_idempotency.value: ("bookings"."idempotency_key" is null and "bookings"."create_request_hash" is null) or ("bookings"."idempotency_key" is not null and length("bookings"."idempotency_key") between 8 and 160 and length("bookings"."create_request_hash") = 64)

ck_customers_phone.name: ck_customers_phone
ck_customers_phone.value: "customers"."phone" is null or length("customers"."phone") between 1 and 40

ck_customers_phone_key.name: ck_customers_phone_key
ck_customers_phone_key.value: "customers"."phone_key" is null or length("customers"."phone_key") between 1 and 40

ck_customers_email.name: ck_customers_email
ck_customers_email.value: "customers"."email" is null or length("customers"."email") between 3 and 254
